body.summary: @fe1d42528, @067af4f5e and the test commit: src/db/subsystem-changes.ts and two sub-databases; the changed-file record is written in-transaction at every grouping-input change (the file commit once per commit; upsertRelations outside a commit; promotions; deleteResolvedRelations; the SQL re-check; the incoming sweep of a removed entity; entity-row removal on every other path). The first t1 test now also covers an outgoing grouping-edge sweep (deleting an entity that holds a CALLS edge records its own file, not the target's) and transactional atomicity (a write transaction that records and then throws leaves no entry, read back after reopening the store; withWriteTxn uses childTransaction, which aborts on a throw). Mutation check: 15 mutants, all caught. Related suites: 368 pass.
